name: io.github.chrischall/artsonia-mcp
description: Parent/fan access to Artsonia student-art portfolios, comments, and fans (AI-built).

environmentVariables.name: ARTSONIA_SESSION_CACHE
environmentVariables.description: Set to false to disable the on-disk session cache and re-authenticate on every process start. Defaults to enabled.

environmentVariables.name: ARTSONIA_SESSION_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path for the session cache file. Defaults to $MCP_DATA_DIR/.artsonia-mcp/session-<user>.json.
